surfaces.title: Admin Overview
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Main admin landing page and shell navigation must render without hiding source-state labels.

surfaces.title: Admin Analytics
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Analytics panels are dense and must keep snapshot/cache states visible.

surfaces.title: Admin Drops
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Drop moderation and approval controls need admin-only browser confirmation.

surfaces.title: Admin Users
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: User metrics must not collapse missing data into healthy zero states.

surfaces.title: Admin User Detail
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: User detail drilldown is identity and support sensitive and requires authenticated browser review.

surfaces.title: Admin Roster
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Creator roster decisions need explicit review/waiting/approved states.

surfaces.title: Admin Debug
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Control Tower must show stale/missing/fallback evidence without raw dumps first.

surfaces.title: Admin AI
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: AI tooling must show enablement, budget, model, and fallback states safely.

surfaces.title: Admin Support
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Support inbox states must distinguish missing thread, permission denial, retryable failure, submitted, and received.

surfaces.title: Admin Moderation
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Moderation must avoid treating weak browser heuristics as confirmed server proof.

surfaces.title: Admin Content
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Content management affordances must be hidden, disabled, or unavailable when not implemented.

surfaces.title: Admin Queue
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Queue states must expose pending/review/source-missing truth.

surfaces.title: Admin Privacy
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Privacy and consent surfaces must keep source and policy boundaries visible.

surfaces.title: Admin Economy
surfaces.browserSmokeReason: Economy views are protected: browser smoke may inspect labels only and cannot prove GumDrop/payment truth.
